صَادِرٌ Returning [from water, &c.]; going, or turning, back, or away: (TA:) quasi-pl. n. ↓ صَدَرٌ . (M, K.) ―
-b2- [Hence the saying,] مَا لَهُ صَادِرٌ وَلَا وَارِدٌ (tropical:) He has not anything: (M, K:) or he has not a thing nor a people. (Lh, M.) ―
-b3- And طَرِيقٌ صَادِرٌ (tropical:) A road, or way, by which people return from water: (S, M, A, K:) opposed to طَرِيقٌ وَارِدٌ. (M, A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
